newsitem.title: INDIA: India's United Front to meet on Friday at 0430 GMT.
newsitem.headline: India's United Front to meet on Friday at 0430 GMT.

text.p: India's United Front coalition will meet on Friday at 10 a.m. (0430 GMT) to discuss replacing caretaker Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda as its leader, Railway Minister Ram Vilas Paswan said.

Paswan spoke to reporters as he left a meeting of the United Front's Steering Committee at which coalition leaders honoured Biju Patnaik, a veteran Janata Dal leader who died in a New Delhi hospital on Thursday.
"Today was a condolence meeting for Biju Patnaik. Tomorrow we will meet again at 10 a.m.," Paswan said.
Asked when the United Front would choose a new leader, Tamil Maanila Congress leader G.K. Moopanar said: "The Steering Committee will decide on it tomorrow."
Moopanar was considered one of the frontrunners to succeed Deve Gowda.
